releases.notes:
Changes
- Added some Changed-themed banner patterns (many are not textured)
- Latex cover will now show up on maps
- Added server log events to diagnose purchasing issues
- Added better player resize handling preventing them from clipping into walls
- Restored latex fluid flowing horizontally
- Latex cover spreads faster and will try to cross edges
- Added `addlevels` subcommand to `/abilitytree`
- Added creative mode capability to purchase and refund ability tree nodes for free

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Pink shorts bug
- Fixed syringe exploit
- Fixed flight stamina overlay rendering way too many wings
- Fixed latex container blocks not breaking correctly
- Fixed suited players drowning in places where they shouldn't
- Fixed TF'd players drowning in creative mode
- Attempted fix visual issue where remote players visually drown in creative mode
- Fixed "seated" entities being able to destroy their seat in places where they shouldn't
- Fixed some block map coloring
- Fixed issue related to post-TF npcs breaking
- Fixed abilitytree command missing tree/node names in suggestions on servers
- Fixed FP arm rendering in the wrong position
- Fixed missing keybinds
- Fixed accessories being visible while the player is suited
- Fixed friendly TF not indicated the ability can be used
- Fixed bounding box rendering not matching 1:1
- Attempted fix players being kicked for climbing walls as stiger
- Fixed logic error in node pricing

releases.notes:
# Changes
+ Added Pure White Latex Cerberus
+ Small facility generation optimization
+ Added server config to disable mob assimilation
+ Added latex drip particles to latex covered ceilings
  + Can be disabled in the client config

# Bug Fixes
+ Attempted fix for crash when ticking an assimilated rabbit
+ Fixed crash related to a missing target for camera tug
+ Attempted fix for mixin conflict with server kernels (e.g. Arclight)
+ Replaced many mixin injectors to use compatibility conscious signatures
+ Fixed crash due to unsafe cast when fast-rendering is disabled with rubidium
+ Fixed legacy fluid block names being untranslated
+ Fixed rain pouring through latex blocks
+ Fixed issue causing invalid camera placement when spectating non-living entities (e.g. Item frames)
+ Fixed crash related to enabling wave vision in spectator mode
+ Fixed basic player info being desynced when an NPC has spawned in
+ Fixed issue prevent players from being assimilated while suited
+ Fixed desync of TF state from grab
+ Fixed tamed DL wolf inventories being "voided" when killed
+ Fixed issue that causes mods to consider latex flasks as potions

# API Changes
+ Added `initializeBPI()` to allow latexes to override their BPI when spawning
+ Added facility piece event system that allows devs to make facility pieces do stuff
